question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Savage
solution: The correct answer is **"Tame."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Savage"** means wild, untamed, or uncontrolled. (अति निर्दय, हिंसक या बर्बर) • **Example**: *It was a brutal and **savage**__ attack.* • **"Tame"** is the opposite of **savage.** • It means domesticated or trained. ((पशु या पक्षी) घरेलू, पालतू (न कि जंगली या लोगों से डरने वाले)) __ • **Example**: *The birds are so **tame**__ they will eat from your hand.* • In the given context, the most appropriate antonym is tame as it is the direct opposite of savage. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 - Robust**: strong or healthy. (तगड़ा और स्‍वस्‍थ) • **Option 3 - Wild**: (used about animals or plants) living or growing in natural conditions, not looked after by people. ((पशु या पौधे) जंगली (प्राकृतिक अवस्‍थाओं में रहने या उगने वाले), वन्‍य) • **Option 4 - Bold**: (used about a person or his/her behaviour) confident and not afraid. ((व्‍यक्ति या उसका व्‍यवहार) आत्‍मविश्‍वासी और निडर) 39:Td31, The correct answer is **"Indolence."**
